response.heading: About your situation
paragraphs: Ikaw ay regular employee ng city treasurer's office at nais mong i-dispute ang isang salary deduction.

Base sa iyong paglalarawan, ito ay isang employment issue na may kinalaman sa isang municipal office. Bago natin magamit ang mga private-sector labor resources, kailangan muna nating malaman kung ito ay government employment dahil ang government employment ay hindi sakop ng labor module na available dito.
Kaya, maaari mo bang kumpirmahin kung ikaw ay government-employed talaga, o kung ikaw ay nagtatrabaho sa isang private company na naka-assign sa nasabing opisina?
response.follow_up: Is this a government-employed position, or are you employed by a private company assigned to that office?
local_paragraphs: You described an employment concern involving a city or municipal office. Before using private-sector labor sources, I need to confirm whether this is government employment. Government employment is outside this project’s selected labor module.
